en.title: Boat Engine Flush Clamp – Test Water Clamp
en.descriptionHtml:
Flush the engine clean – simply, on dry land

Salt, sand and algae take a heavy toll on a boat engine's cooling system. Skipping a rinse after time on the water is one of the most common causes of costly repairs.

Connect the hose and start the engine

The flush clamp fits easily over the engine's water intake and connects to a standard garden hose. That lets you flush the cooling system with fresh water right on dry land, without launching the boat at all.

Features

  • Makes it easy to rinse the engine with fresh water
  • Connects directly to a standard garden hose
  • Protects the cooling system against salt and corrosion
  • Fits most outboard engines and clamps on securely
  • Extends the engine's lifespan

30-day satisfaction guarantee. Not fully satisfied? Get in touch within 30 days and we'll sort it out – no hassle.
